chunks.title: OWASP REST Security Cheat Sheet
chunks.excerpt: Secure REST services must only provide HTTPS endpoints. This protects authentication credentials in transit, for example passwords, API keys or JSON Web Tokens.

chunks.title: OWASP REST Security Cheat Sheet
chunks.excerpt: Passwords, security tokens, and API keys should not appear in the URL, as this can be captured in web server logs, which makes them intrinsically valuable.
